description:
Model a standard 2x2 interlocking plastic brick (compatible with LEGO dimensions) in FreeCAD.

Specifications:
1. Main Body: Length 15.8mm, Width 15.8mm, Height 9.6mm.
2. Top Studs: 4 studs, Diameter 4.8mm, Height 1.8mm, Spacing 8mm center-to-center (centered on top face).
3. Shell: Hollow the brick from the bottom with a uniform wall thickness of 1.2mm.
4. Internal Tube: Add a central reinforcement tube inside the cavity (Outer Diameter 6.5mm, Inner Diameter 4.8mm) extending from the inner roof to the bottom plane.

Save the result as a single solid body to '/home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/brick_2x2.FCStd'.
